item.title: About Us
item.description: Welcome to our store! We are passionate about offering a curated collection of the world’s most sought-after pre-owned luxury handbags. Our mission is to make luxury accessible, affordable, and sustainable.

item.title: Our Authenticity Guarantee
item.description: Every item we sell is 100% authentic, guaranteed. Each bag undergoes a rigorous multi-point inspection by our team of in-house expert authenticators before it is listed.

item.title: Q&A
item.description:
Are all of your items authentic?

Yes. We have a zero-tolerance policy for counterfeits. Every item is authenticated by our experts.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes, we ship to customers all around the world.

item.title: Refund Policy
item.description: We offer a 14-day return window from the date of delivery. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return it for a full refund. Please see terms for details.

item.title: Shipping Policy
item.description: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. We offer worldwide express shipping, which typically takes 3-5 business days to arrive after dispatch from our facility in Japan.
